The procedure to replace a light switch is as follows. 1) Turn off power supply at the main circuit breaker or fuse box. 2) Remove the old switch from its mounting bracket and remove it from the wall. 3) Install the new switch in place of the old one. 4) Connect the wires to the new switch according to the wiring diagram provided with the switch. 5) Reconnect the power supply to the circuit. 6) Test the switch to ensure that it works properly.
